description: Use when an agent must translate text (replies, filings, contracts, transcripts). Input: text (max 1500 chars, GET or POST JSON), target code, optional source (when omitted the model identifies it, incl. Spanish/French/German). Output: translatedText, source, sourceDetected, model, fallback, cost fields. Keeps numbers, KRW amounts, dates and names. Not stored. Example: ?text=Hello%2C%20how%20are%20you%3F&target=ko Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

source.description: Source language (optional; default auto: the model identifies it and the response says sourceDetected: true). A given source always wins

text.description: Text to translate (1-1500 chars). Empty or longer → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: ai_translate
title: Translate text between 19 languages (Korean, Japanese, Chinese, English, European) with an LLM; finance and legal terms, numbers and currencies kept
